summary: Keep the test-only OTLP collector out of the installed st3 package identity.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The runtime executable and collector-backed OTLP export tests are unchanged. The collector is resolved only when Nix checks run.

downtime.detail: Collector-only input updates no longer change the installed package identity or trigger a downstream package-based daemon restart.

manual.detail: No manual configuration changes are required.
